verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents strong first-party primitives for autonomous background automation: cron triggers, Queues, and Workflows that chain steps, auto-retry, and persist state for minutes to weeks with no infra to manage, plus an Agents SDK where stateful agents hibernate when idle and wake on demand, supporting scheduling, MCP, and workflows. However, community evidence (cloudflare-comm-9) reports that Workers' CPU-time limits (30s free / 15min paid) don't work for genuinely long-running agent tasks, pushing some builders to self-hosted alternatives for such workloads. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that Workflows/Agents reliably sustain long autonomous background runs, and clearer resolution of the CPU-limit concerns raised by users.
